registered_before_implementation: 2026-10-18 afternoon; read-only latest crash dump points to m_lxe and prior dumps vary across interpreter/array/Simulink runtime modules
hypothesis: Check for an observable arithmetic/array/runtime failure without any motor, observer, configuration callback, model loading, Simulink API or physical simulation. A failure may isolate a broader computing problem; a pass does not establish hardware health, a fixed native cause or R2 qualification.
oracle: Before either test compile/run, create65536 uint32 seeds0..65535. For each element perform32 LCG transitions x=(1664525*x+1013904223) mod2^32 using independent Python integer arithmetic. Store the exact little-endian262144-byte vector, SHA256 and FNV1a32 of all bytes. Record generator source SHA. Verify known scalar cases by Python arbitrary-precision calculations; never regenerate an oracle after a numeric failure.
native_control: Compile one new standalone C program using the existing private MinGW8.1 and fixed-O2 flags. C uses wrapping uint32 arithmetic and computes full-buffer FNV1a32 every cycle against preregistered oracle. Run a single process for60 seconds, at least4 cycles, at most100000 cycles; one thread, no priority/affinity/power/clock settings changed. Stop at first mismatch, retain its cycle/processor index and output vector. Final vector SHA256 must equal Python oracle independently.
matlab_control: Only if native control passes, one new hidden MATLAB batch, fresh project MATLAB_PREFDIR, default paths plus diagnostic entry only, same-singleCompThread flag. No compiler setup needed. Implement LCG with double integers and modulo2^32, where all intermediates are below2^53 and exactly representable. Reset seeds each cycle and perform32 transitions; convert to uint32 little-endian bytes and verify full SHA256 each cycle for60 seconds, at least4 cycles, at most100000 cycles. Preserve output vector and last progress on mismatch. Final vector must also equal the exact oracle. No JIT disabling, alternate numerical libraries, tolerance or retries.
observations: Record executable/source/contract/oracle hashes, default process affinity mask observed only, compiler/runtime version, cycle counts/durations, current processor histogram for native control, first failed cycle if any, progress, exits and final byte hashes. Max application buffers well below128MiB. Raw MATLAB logs stay private. Verify all820 frozen files before/after.
policy: One compile and one native process; one MATLAB process only on native pass. Zero retry after build/native/runtime/numeric failure, no relabel, no main model, no formal matrix, no source or system settings changes. Existing failed candidates stay closed. Any new evidence must be interpreted without asserting cause from absence of failure.
